name: discovery
title: Discovery call
outcome: Qualified for a migration planning follow-up

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello Maya, this is the CallOps demo assistant. Is now still a good time to discuss Northstar HVAC's service scheduling?

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: Yes. We have 12 technicians and handle about 300 service visits each month.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: What is hardest in your current workflow?

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: We currently use spreadsheets to assign jobs, and dispatch loses time each morning.

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: My main concern is switching during our winter peak. We need a clear migration plan.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood. What budget have you set aside?

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: We can spend up to $8,000 for setup, if the migration is manageable.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: When would you want to start?

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: Ideally by November, before the winter rush.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'll send the migration outline and pricing proposal by Friday, then we can review it next week.

turns.speaker: CONTACT
turns.text: That works. Please include a short demo for our operations manager.
